verdict.rationale: The pack only hints at multi-item work. Revenue analytics can filter data and export it to CSV, and the Dunning Agent works through overdue invoices one customer at a time, chasing each and handing the rest to a person. Neither amounts to a documented bulk mutation capability. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API endpoint (e.g., batch event ingestion or bulk invoice/subscription actions), bulk actions in the UI, bulk operations exposed through the MCP server or AI agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
